one_line: LLMs edit weights, Anthropic ramps compute, AI infrastructure investments surge.

themes.title: LLMs edit weights directly
themes.text: MIT researchers demonstrated that a large language model (GPT‑6 Astra) can examine and modify a neural network’s weights, changing only 0.016% of parameters and raising MATH‑500 and GSM8K scores. In a separate experiment, GPT‑6 Astra edited 0.016% of Qwen3.5‑0.8B weights, boosting math reasoning up to sixfold and instruction following threefold.

stories.headline: MIT researchers show LLMs can read and edit neural network weights without retraining
GPT-6 Astra edits 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B weights, boosting math performance sixfold

themes.title: Anthropic's compute spending and IPO prep
themes.text: Anthropic disclosed $895.4 billion in compute purchase commitments and leases while reporting a 1,100% revenue increase to $17 billion for the quarter. The company also highlighted slower revenue growth and financing risks as it prepares for an upcoming IPO.

stories.headline: Anthropic reports 1,100% revenue surge ahead of IPO, commits $895B to compute
Anthropic reports $895.4 billion in compute‑related purchase commitments and leases
Anthropic revenue growth slows as compute financing risks rise ahead of IPO

themes.title: Investments in AI infrastructure
themes.text: Oracle announced $20 billion in stock and bond sales to fund AI data‑center expansion. NVIDIA is deploying physical and agentic AI services in cities worldwide. OpenAI launched a Grid Protectors Program to improve compute‑campus power reliability. Lumen Technologies and Microsoft expanded co‑selling to deliver AI‑ready enterprise networks.
